name: 니오베
quote: 무너지는 바위조차 나의 의지를 꺾을 수 없다.
face: 두꺼운 뿔 아래 굳게 다문 입
outfit: 황금색 테두리가 박힌 짙은 남색 갑옷

visual_en: A heavy-set rhino-like creature facing right, featuring massive dark stone horns with golden veins. The head has bright emerald eyes and short dark brown fur. It wears thick navy blue armor decorated with ornate golden trim and a glowing emerald gem at the collar. The character carries an enormous hexagonal stone shield with glowing green cracks. The arms are encased in heavy metallic gauntlets, and the feet are sturdy stone boots. The overall silhouette is squat and extremely sturdy, with a bright emerald glow emanating from its center to stand out against dark dungeon floors.
pose_en: Standing firmly with a wide stance, bracing for impact.
